title: cs-daily-account-reminders-elena-2026-03-13
content:
Daily scratchpad — quick / messy. For my eyes + handoff.

TODAY (Fri 2026-03-13) TOPS:
- Prep slides + 5 bullet agenda for ACME QBR (Mon 3/15, 10am PT). Need: token spend by route, 90d latency trend, 2 production incidents summary, recommendation (reduce burst by 30% -> show cost delta).
- Renewals: Nimbus Labs renewal negotiation — deadline 2026-06-30. Check pending PO and legal flags. Set intro call w/ renewal AE? Samir to lead pricing ask.
- Support escalations: Helix/CS-1245 still open (embedding mismatch on 512->768). Eng response ETA? If >24h escalate to SRE channel.

TIMEBOX (my calendar):
- 8:30-9:00 — Inbox triage + flag urgent replies
- 9:00-9:30 — Draft ACME QBR agenda + slide skeleton
- 10:00-11:00 — 1:1 Samir (renewal strategy)
- 11:30-12:00 — Touchpoint Helix (support sync)
- 13:00-14:00 — Lunch + quick notes
- 14:00-15:00 — Pull metrics (console dashboards)
- 15:30-16:00 — Draft renewal email Nimbus

ACCOUNTS / NOTES (quick):
1) Acme Inc. (prod: chat + embeddings)
   - QBR Mon 3/15 10am PT w/ CSM, Eng mgr, Prod owner (Marisa).
   - Ask list: 30/60/90 token spend trend; 95th pct latency; top 3 error signatures last 90d.
   - Risks: noticed increased tail latency after model switch 2/12. Root cause suspected batching config change. Action: ask infra for current batching window + fallback plan.
   - Prep asks for slide: clear before/after lat graph, cost delta, recommended rollback vs config tweak.

2) Nimbus Labs (contract renewal)
   - Renewal target: 2026-06-30. Currently on metered plus reserved pilot.
   - TODO: confirm monthly committed tokens, check if they want Dedicated pilot extension.
   - Pricing negotiation notes: wants 15% discount for 12mo commit; propose: 10% + 30 day performance SLA commitment. Samir to draft counter.

3) Helix Analytics (support)
   - Ticket JIRA-CS-1245: embedding dimension mismatch + stale cache. Customer reports regression post-deploy 3/09.
   - Quick triage: ask eng to validate model config (embedding-dim param), clear cached prefixes, re-run eval subset.
   - If not fixed by EOD -> schedule remediation call and offer temporary query rate limit to reduce errors.

QUICK EMAIL TEMPLATES (short):
- ACME QBR invite follow-up:
  Hi Marisa / team — attaching the QBR agenda + 10m pre-meet asks. Please drop any specific metrics you want covered. See attached: three graphs (cost, latency, errors).

- Nimbus renewal outreach:
  Hi [Name], checking in on renewal timeline. Would a short call next week to align pricing and commitment options work? Draft options attached.

NOTES TO ENG (short bullets):
- Batching window: can we get exact window used for Acme production from 2/01-3/10? Want to overlay with latency spikes. (linked: CONFLUENCE-qbr-playbook)
- Embedding dim mismatch: which deploys changed embedding pipeline 3/09 — tag commits/PRs. (linked: JIRA-CS-1245)

PRIORITY ACTIONS (assign):
- Pull acme 90d token spend by route + top endpoints (Elena, due EOD Fri)
- Samir: draft Nimbus pricing counter (due Tue 3/17)
- Lina: ping infra for batching config + logs (due today)
- Eng oncall: patch for Helix cache + temp mitigation (due <24h)

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOS (brainstorm):
- Should we propose a small Dedicated slot for Nimbus for stability? Cost tradeoffs? get numbers.
- For QBR, how much raw telemetry to show vs. synthesized recommendations? They prefer concrete steps.
- Any new compliance asks from Nimbus legal? search past emails.

LINKS / QUICK REFERENCES:
- JIRA CS-1245 (Helix)
- Confluence: qbr-playbook (internal template)
- Dashboard: console -> accounts -> Acme -> usage -> 90d
- Calendar: Mon 2026-03-15 10am PT (ACME QBR)

RANDOM/ME NOTES:
- keep slides to 6-7 slides + 1 appendix (incidents & logs).
- bring 2 suggested mitigations (config tweak + rollback) with cost impact.
- be explicit about ask: approval to schedule maintenance window if needed.

END — will tidy before sending slides. If anything blocks, ping me in #cs-acct-elena.

-- e.m.
